---
title: "Notebooks"
---

The notebook suite gives GDSFactory developers executable examples for public OrPen layout cells, SGB geometry handoff, Palace simulation setup, Slurm handoff package generation, and `gsim` result review.

Quarto renders the linked `.ipynb` files as first-class documentation pages. In this docs tree, `docs-quarto/docs` is a symlink to the repo-level `docs/` notebooks and `docs-quarto/sgb-notebooks` is a symlink to `notebooks/SGB_Geometry_Tutorials/`; the Jupytext sources live under `notebooks/src/`. By default, the site build shows the checked-in notebook cells and outputs; to force execution of a notebook, run:

```bash
quarto render docs-quarto/docs/notebooks/public_electrostatic_workflow.ipynb --execute
```

The report cells are intentionally fail-fast. They require real Palace outputs from a completed run folder, usually by setting `NOTEBOOK_ANALYSIS_RUN_ROOT`; the docs should not fabricate result tables.
